title: Built a market conditions indicator (FREE)
author: No_Page5992
selftext:
Hi guys,

I've been building a free TradingView indicator called '' OrcaTrading - Market Conditions V2''  
And I'd love some honest feedback from other traders for improvement.

This tool will forever remain free, I am not trying to sell anything here. Just trying to collect some extra and external feedback.

What is it?

The idea of this indicator is to help the trader to solve a fairly simple question:  
'' Should I even be looking for trades right now? ''

Instead of creating a entry focused indicator, I focused on market quality, which is what I believe many traders fail to determine.

I see traders often take trades simply because they see their setup forming, not taking in consideration about overall market environment.

A A+ setup in a bad quality market is still a bad trade.

Full explanation of how the indicator works is in the description!

If you have any question now, feel free to ask.

ATTENTION:  
This is a repost.  
Had to re-publish the indicator, meaning the old one did not work anymore for users.  
Here's the new published one!:  
[https://www.tradingview.com/script/9bZA7u2T-OrcaTrading-Market-Conditions-Tool/](https://www.tradingview.com/script/9bZA7u2T-OrcaTrading-Market-Conditions-Tool/)

Support by boosting and commenting on the indicator would be much appreciated!

comments.author: Otherwise_Wave9374
comments.body:
Cool approach focusing on market quality instead of entries. A lot of people ignore regime and then wonder why the same setup works one week and gets chopped up the next.

When you ask for feedback, what are you using as the "ground truth" for good/bad conditions (volatility bands, trend strength, chop metrics, etc.)? Also would be nice if the tool explicitly says what to do: trade trend, trade mean reversion, or stand aside.

If you want a marketing angle, Id frame it as a pre-trade checklist tool, not a signal generator. Ive got a short writeup on positioning stuff like this without sounding salesy here: https://blog.promarkia.com/

replies.author: No_Page5992
replies.body:
Thanks pal!

We use multiple confirmations for this to operate, including market structure.
For example to see if price is actually moving or not, we use mainly ADX, but not only.
For several outcomes to pop up, multiple things need to align.
It's a lot to share here in a comment, if you're interested shoot me a DM and I could share some time later when I am back in office.

replies.author: No_Page5992
replies.body:
Also, right now it actually tells you what to do!
It gives signals such as:
- ON long/short
- WATCH long/short
- CAUTION
- OFF

Although some users might want to look for their entries during WATCH status already, while others want to trade only during ON status.
This is up to them to discover and find out of course.

This is a tool, and should only be used as a tool.
See this as another great confluence to people's existing strategies.
